title: MODE 2: CMPLX (Complex Numbers)
summary: Rectangular (a+bi) and polar (r∠θ) arithmetic on complex numbers.

body.text: In CMPLX, the imaginary unit i is the ENG key unshifted. Use this mode for AC circuit phasors, polynomial roots with imaginaries, and polar conversions. SHIFT EXE (Re⇔Im) toggles the real and imaginary parts of a result.

body.caption: Each complex number is an arrow from the origin. Adding them is the parallelogram rule: the resultant is 4 − 2i.

body.label: Display form
body.text: Polar vs rectangular presentation depends on calculator settings and conversion functions (Pol/Rec). Confirm angle unit before interpreting θ.
